reason: Steel could form a support for the mattress, making a sheltered berth.
expectation: The steel and mattress will make a bed frame with a mattress.

effect: Steel cannot currently combine with the mattress, but it can combine with the reflective insulation.
reaction: I expected to build a mattress support first, so the insulation pairing is a surprise.
reason: The failed attempt identified reflective insulation as a compatible partner for steel.
expectation: They will form an insulated structure for the sheltered berth, though its exact form is unclear.

effect: The steel and insulation made a raised, insulated berth frame ready for the mattress.
reaction: The frame's insulation beneath the deck makes its purpose clearer.
reason: The mattress fits the newly built berth frame.
expectation: The mattress will complete the sheltered sleeping berth.

effect: The mattress completed the cave berth and the chapter's goal.
reaction: The boots under the frame and lamps beyond the partition make the finished space feel lived in.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the insulated berth frame was worthwhile: its raised deck and insulation explain how the sleeping space is kept off the cold floor.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial mattress-and-steel attempt was unproductive, though its partner list helped reveal the required sequence.

surprise.text: Steel had to be combined with insulation before the mattress, rather than making a frame with the mattress directly.

arbitrary.text: The required order initially felt a little arbitrary: a mattress could plausibly go onto a steel frame before insulation was added, although the completed frame's design made physical sense.

continue.text: I would continue to see the growing room put to use; the practical details here made the expedition feel tangible, even if this chapter was brief.
